home.heroTitle: Archicad tools that work on real projects

shop.metaDescription: Choose a Nordlab plugin, send a purchase request, and get a reply with pricing or download guidance.
shop.title: Buy Nordlab plugins
shop.lead: Choose the plugin you need, send a short request, and we'll reply with pricing, licensing details, or installation help for the current Nordlab add-on lineup.
highlights: Choose a plugin and tell us how many seats you need.
We'll reply manually with pricing, licensing terms, and install guidance.
We'll then move you into the correct activation flow and send the next step for payment or invoicing.
trustPoints: A license for a real Archicad workflow rather than a generic demo tool.
Help with installation, first launch, and choosing the right usage scenario for your bureau or project.
A follow-up activation flow with machine ID support and a license key after payment.

about.title: About
about.lead: Nordlab — independent Archicad development by a practicing architect.
about.body: I design and build add-ons used on live projects: terrain from DWG, landscape distribution, shells on mesh, selection tables, and batch ID workflows. Registered Graphisoft API Developer. Archicad 27–29, Windows.

download.title: Download Nordlab plugins
download.lead: Trial builds for Archicad 27–29 (Windows). Each plugin includes 10 free launches before activation.
download.trialNote: After trial, purchase a license in the shop and activate with your machine ID inside the add-on.
installSteps: Download the .apx file for your Archicad version.
In Archicad: Add-ons → Add-On Manager → Install, then select the file.
Restart Archicad and open the add-on from the Extensions menu.
